request.description: The submission by reference with its timeline (sent, review, sanctioned, disbursed) and the first open document request as `pendingDocument`. Compat layer for the current app (plan §10.3): the app sets `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=<host>/v0`. The case is the borrower's newest open application, resolved server side because the app never sends one. Removed once the app moves to `/v1`.

response.name: 200 OK
